notes: Post-mortem fix for the 2026-07-25 Supabase outage (03:56-05:30, Cloudflare 522 on every request incl. trivial counts; recovered only on manual restart; Supabase status page green throughout, so project-specific). Root cause is two-part: (1) STRUCTURAL - 3.9GB database on a 1GB-RAM instance (shared_buffers 256MB, effective_cache_size 768MB), working set ~4x RAM; (2) TRIGGER - EbayFpDetector's batch fetch ranked #1 in pg_stat_statements by total time BY A WIDE MARGIN (60,595 calls / 11,368s / 8.98M shared_blks_read at 10.6% miss, vs 3,931s for #2). It selected every snapshot row for a batch of 15 sets and kept only the newest per set in JS - measured 437 rows / ~1MB of TOASTed listings_json to use 14. Replaced with get_latest_ebay_pricing() using a lateral LIMIT 1 per set. NOTE: DISTINCT ON is the obvious fix and is a TRAP - it dedupes server-side but still scans all 184 rows (buffers unchanged at 190); only the lateral stops after the first row per set (12 rows, buffers 57). CRITICAL DEPLOY NOTE: /api/cron/ebay-fp-cleanup is driven by Discord-Messenger jobs/hb_crons.py against HB_BASE=localhost:3000 at 04:00/04:15/04:30/04:45 UTC (four runs in one hour, right after hb_full_sync at 03:45 UTC) - so this fix is INERT on Vercel and only takes effect via the local NSSM rebuild. Also dropped price_snapshots_keepa_backup_20260702 (309MB/1,252,729 rows, unused since 2026-07-03, no dependents); 94.5% were exact duplicates, 47,762 of the unique rows were the corrupt cohort PR #500 removed, and Chris chose drop-as-is over restoring the 21,335 sane rows (17 sets lost all history, largest 75109-1 Obi-Wan at 452 rows - irreversible). Follow-up PR #634 open: MCP apply_migration stamped its own versions (20260725062134/20260725064454) rather than the committed filenames, so the files were renamed to match and stop a future db:push re-running them. Rollback: revert f6384584 (code only - the migrations are already applied and the table drop is NOT reversible).
